records.text: Replied the broker's daughter O thou daughter of a dog!

records.reference: AND HAVING THUS ISLAMISED SHE ASKED HIM DO MEN IN THE FAITH OF AL ISLAM GIVE MARRIAGE PORTIONS TO WOMEN OR DO WOMEN DOWER MEN
records.text: And having thus Islamized, she asked him, Do men in the faith of Al Islam give marriage portions to women, or do women dower men?
